text: This chatbot answers questions using a small knowledge base stored in ChromaDB, a vector database.
Each knowledge entry is turned into a vector with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence-transformers model before it is stored.
When you ask a question, the chatbot embeds it, retrieves the three most similar entries, and sends them to the language model as context.
Answers are generated by a Llama model served through the Groq API.
To add your own knowledge, edit data/knowledge.json and run populate_knowledge.py again. Entries with an existing id are overwritten.
Support hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Questions sent outside those hours are answered the next working day.
